text:
maria: Heads up — can we confirm last-mile billing/alloc for the canary tomorrow 02:00–05:00 UTC? Need 4x H100 in eu-west1 for model sweep. Terraform PR linked below but vendor asks for invoice clearance before hard-reserve. @oscar any status? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4827 (tf var `h100_canary=true`).

oscar: We're on it. Vendor put a soft-hold reserve but finance flagged an outstanding invoice for eu-west1. If finance clears, vendor will convert to hard reserve. Tagging @sachin for quota consumption warning.

sachin: I saw quota creeping up — current GPU quota 120, used 116. Quick check: `rwi infra quota show --region eu-west1 --resource h100` returns 116/120. If we spin 4 more, we'll cross hard limit. We can request temporary bump but lead time ~2-4 hrs. Recommend fallback to a100 mix.

oncall-bot: Quota alert: eu-west1 h100 utilization at 96% (116/120). Threshold breached. Auto-notify sent to infra-oncall.

hana: If perf is not strictly H100-only, we can do 2xH100 + 2xA100 fallback automatically. Add route policy: `fallback_policy: [h100, a100]` in the canary config.

maria: Prefer H100 for latency-sensitive sections. If finance can't clear, we'll accept fallback but please keep fallback within same instance family if possible. Updated PR with tags: `billing:canary-eu-west1`, `owner:maria` — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4827#issuecomment-1

oscar: Thanks — finance pinged back, they started APAC/EU invoice reconciliation, but no final ok yet. If you add `grant_temp_quota=true` to the PR vars I can request the bump while finance finishes. They usually approve emergency bumps same day.

sachin: I can issue a temporary quota bump once PR merged + tag present. Command I'll run: ```bash
rwi admin quota-bump --region eu-west1 --resource h100 --increase 8 --expires 2026-03-21T08:00:00Z
``` Will confirm here when done.

maria: Done — pushed `grant_temp_quota=true` and added a short note in PR about expected rollback window. Also added canary fallback config. Please merge when ready.

oncall-bot: Deploy bot: terraform plan for infra/pr/4827 completed. No drift detected.

sachin: I will merge and request bump in ~10m. If it doesn't land within 30m we fallback to 2H100/2A100.

hana: :thumbsup: I'll queue the warmup job on the mixed pool after merge.

maria: Appreciate it — thanks all. Will stand by during quiet window.
